scope: Replace 1,277 vertically repeated flat coin-spill clusters with fourteen floor-supported complete Meshy mounds; keep native proportions, rotate/overlap whole piles, and move the rear chest onto the floor in front of its mound.
delivery: Local only. No push, publication, artifact upload or remote deployment. Authorized Meshy jobs sent small text requests only.
texturePolicy: 2K colour, 512px vector-filtered normals and 256px packed material data. Linear-light Lanczos3 and restrained colour sharpening. Lossy colour must pass PSNR >= 40 dB, p99 <= 8 and max <= 64; otherwise lossless WebP. Data maps use lossless WebP. All original geometry and UV accessors are exact.
